description: Evals for CI & DevOps expert skill covering workflow setup, deployment, and server configuration scenarios

evals.prompt: I need a GitHub Actions workflow for a Laravel + React app in an Nx monorepo. It should run tests on PRs using nx affected for ci-test, with PHP 8.4 and Node 22 setup, Composer caching, and parallel execution.
evals.expected_output: A GitHub Actions YAML workflow file with: checkout@v7 (fetch-depth: 0), shivammathur/setup-php with PHP 8.4 + pdo_sqlite, pnpm/action-setup + setup-node with cache, composer cache, git fetch origin main for BASE_SHA, and pnpm exec nx affected -t ci-test.

evals.prompt: Write a VPS deploy script for a Laravel app with atomic symlink releases. It should include composer install, npm build, migrate, OPcache reload, and health check.
evals.expected_output: A bash deploy script that: creates timestamped release directory, runs composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader + npm ci && npm run build, symlinks shared .env/storage, runs php artisan optimize + migrate --force, swaps current symlink atomically, runs systemctl reload php8.4-fpm + php artisan queue:restart, and does a curl health check with rollback on failure.

evals.prompt: I need a Supervisor configuration for Laravel Horizon workers on a production VPS with multiple queues and memory leak protection.
evals.expected_output: A supervisor .ini file with: program:laravel-worker, numprocs=4, command with queue=high,default,low and --max-time=3600 --tries=3, stopwaitsecs=3600, autorestart=true, stopasgroup=true, killasgroup=true. Explains why stopwaitsecs must exceed longest job and why path uses current/ symlink.
